items.identifiedDescription: The blade Voss kept from his Lantern years. Plain steel, one hand, a lamp-brass guard gone dull and an edge he still keeps honest.
items.note: Lantern Guard issue · never handed back

items.identifiedDescription: Names, times, and three pages someone tried to tear out.
Sewn into Lillian's coat lining—old teeth, no inn tag. Faint lamp oil and river fog.
items.note: The Empty Coat · in Voss's care

items.identifiedDescription: A stamped brass house token, the kind a tavern hands over for a drink or the door. Kept as part of the case record. The reverse carries the house's mark and its street, worn but legible.
items.unidentifiedDescription: A brass tavern token, river-dull and greasy at the rim. Something is stamped on the reverse, too worn to read at a glance.

items.identifiedDescription: A plain iron skullcap with a reinforced brow and a narrow nasal guard. Worn smooth where the straps meet the rim.
Long steel splints riveted over a dark leather backing, with broad shoulder straps and a skirt of overlapping plates. The leather gives where solid plate would bind.
